<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-size: x-large;"><i>Befriend a Distant State While Attacking a Neighbor</i></span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>

</p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
In 266 B.C., the Wei national Fan Ju (<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">范雎</span></span>,
died 255 B.C.) fled to the State of Qin after enduring persecution
and torture by the Wei chancellor, Wei Qi (<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">魏齐</span></span>),
and vowed revenge upon his home state. King Zhaoxiang (<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">秦昭襄王</span></span>,
325–251 B.C.) of Qin was considering attacking the distant State of
Qi. Fan Ju advised the king that, as he would have to pass through
the nearer states of Han and Wei, it would be better to ally himself
with Qi, and also Chu, in defeating Han and Wei. This strategy proved
successful, and King Zhaoxiang was impressed, and appointed Fan Ju as
chancellor of Qin [8], [18].</span></p>

<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-family: Liberation Serif, serif; font-size: large;"><i><span style="font-weight: normal;">Befriend
a Distant State While Attacking a Neighbor</span></i></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
is associated with the 38th hexagram, <i>Fire
over Lake</i>. There is
a polarity depicted here as the Lake move downward and fire moves
moves upward. The hexagram's strong yang line in the second position
(from the bottom) aids the distant weak yin line in the fifth
position in defeating the yang line in the fourth position This can
also be understood to mean that two opposing approaches can be made
to serve each other [1],
[28].</span></p>
<br><br><br>

<div dir="ltr" id="Section75" style="column-count: 2;"><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;">
	<span style="color: #333333;">1) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">这里的外国人几乎都来自委内瑞拉或者波</span></span>
    </span>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;斯。</span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: medium;">Trans.: Almost all of the
	foreigners here are from Venezuela or Persia.</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<div class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-align: left; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	2) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">申请签证的话，你应该过桥，然后去公安</span></span>
    </span>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;局签证科。</span></span></span></div>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<div class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-align: left; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	3) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">在这里，甚至没有暴风雨的时候，也还能</span></span>
    </span>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;看到闪电。</span></span></span></div>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	4) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">你应该用刀子把它切开。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<div class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-align: left; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	5)<span style="font-family: times;"> </span></span><span style="color: #ffa400; font-size: large;"><span style="color: #0047AB !important;">我爸爸在外交部工作，以后我也想做外交</span></span>
    <span style="color: #0047AB !important;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;工作。</span></span></div>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	6) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">他长大了，可以自己剪手指甲和脚趾甲。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	7) </span><span style="color: #ffa400; font-size: large;"><span style="color: #0047AB !important;">有一只很大的动物在森林里攻击了他。</span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
   	8) </span><span style="color: #ffa400; font-size: large;"><span style="color: #0047AB !important;">他们停止了进攻。</span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	9)<span style="font-family: times;"> 西汉结束后就是东汉。</span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	10) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">请把叉子、勺子和盘子放到桌子上。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: medium;">Trans.: Please put the forks,
	spoons and plates on the table.</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	11) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">请把天花板上的电风扇关掉，可以吗？</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	12)  <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">我为你感到骄傲。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	13)  </span><span style="color: #ffa400; font-size: large;"><span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span style="color: #0047AB !important;" lang="zh-CN">地板和墙都是木头的。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span face="Noto Sans CJK SC Black, sans-serif" style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif;"><span lang="en-US">14)</span></span>
	</span><span style="color: #333333; font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular; font-size: large;"><span lang="zh-CN">他对人很热情。</span></span></p>
</div>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><br />

</p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
